title: coelogyne reniformis
intro: Coelogyne reniformis, commonly known as the Reniform Coelogyne or Boat-Shaped Coelogyne, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Coelogyne reniformis include its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm its effects.
